response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong credentials across web, embedded, and infrastructure roles, but he lacks the core requirements for this position: sustained hands-on C++ development on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and any capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure. His most recent finance-adjacent role (RIDE Capital) used Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not C++, and his only real C++ experience was brief (Dec 2014–Jun 2015) and unrelated to finance.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
Demonstrated adaptability across many languages and domains
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months in 2014-2015), not on Windows platform, no recent use
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; only generic SQL/MongoDB/MySQL listed
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience despite one fintech role using unrelated tech stack

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/relevant C++ Windows experience
No fixed income / capital markets domain exposure
